`FHIRResource` is declared in core at `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-emr-api/src/types/fhir-resource.ts`, and the framework exposes it to the chart through `@openmrs/esm-framework`. Three chart files use it directly. Several more use it indirectly through the vitals hook.

**Direct users (most affected)**

1. **Vitals bundle type**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/types.ts:1-8`. `FHIRSearchBundleResponse` wraps `entry: Array<FHIRResource>`. A change to the entry shape changes this type.
2. **Encounter UUID extraction**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts:561-566`. `extractEncounterUuid` is typed as `FHIRResource['resource']['encounter']` and reads `encounter.reference`. It is called from the vitals mapper (line 345 and line 513), so changes to `encounter` affect the encounter IDs on every vitals row.
3. **Lab/observation lookup in the form-entry app**: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/form-data-source/form-data-source.service.ts:227-266`. The `$lastn` Observation call is typed as `{ entry: Array<FHIRResource> }`. The reducer reads `resource.resourceType`, `code.coding`, `valueString`, `valueQuantity.value` and `valueCodeableConcept.coding`, so any change to those fields breaks it.
4. Import of the type: `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts:2-10` and `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-form-entry-app/src/app/form-data-source/form-data-source.service.ts:6`.

**Indirect users (through the vitals hook and mapper)**

5. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts:226-246`. `useVitalsAndBiometrics` types its SWR paging with `FHIRSearchBundleResponse`, so it inherits any change to the bundle entries.
6. `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/data.resource.ts:480-513`. `mapVitalsAndBiometrics` calls `extractEncounterUuid(resource.encounter)`.
7. Components that consume the hook: `vitals-and-biometrics-header/vitals-header.extension.tsx:45`, `vitals/vitals-overview.component.tsx:60`, `biometrics/biometrics-base.component.tsx:47`, and `components/weight-tile/weight-tile.component.tsx:17`.

**Not affected**

- `esm-form-entry-app/src/openmrs-esm-framework.mock.ts:41` declares its own local `FHIRResource` for tests, so it would not change with core. It would only drift from the real type.
- The `FHIRObservationResource` types in `esm-patient-tests-app` and `esm-patient-vitals-app/src/common/types.ts:31` are local declarations, not the core type.

**Core declaration**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-emr-api/src/types/fhir-resource.ts:1-26`. The `FHIRResource` interface defines the `resource` fields listed above.

I did not read the extent of the local mock interface, so its line range is just the declaration line. The hook's full range and the form-entry function's start line were not read, so those ranges are approximate.
